claims.claim: Players experience severe performance issues such as frame drops, stuttering, and freezes that persist despite changing graphics settings.

citations.review_text:
I shouldn't be having any issues with handling this game on my machine. However, i have experienced horrible framedrops ranging from just a small frameskip all the way to a >5 second freeze. I have tried every single graphics preset and nothing helps. (and from my research it appears i'm not the only one experiencing this)

Also greeting me with an 8GB update right after installing the game was some incredible timing.

Overwatch 2 might be one of the most unpleasant playing experiences I ever had. I have tried countless things, from graphics setting changes to hacky solutions. CPU affinity, messing with my driver settings, changing my cache size. Nothing "fixed" the problem, the closest it got was Shader Cache Size making the first launch horrible, then about 10% more bearable.

If I continued to list things I tried, this review would be longer than it would be needed. I ran the game through a quick CapFrameX capture, and the stuttering chart was actually abyssmal. For anybody interested, I have embedded every change I made into my notes for Overwatch 2, where they can permanently stay :D

All of my gameplay time during this review, has literally all been mindless testing. The game system minimum claimed the game only needed 6 GB of system RAM, yet in-game, it was using more than 9 GB, straining my RAM (which I already cannot afford to buy more of) so badly.

The game worked fine on a gaming laptop that was horribly built, and deserves more scrutinity tham that version of Overwatch did. I pick the game back up a few years later, and it runs like I have a two core.

Please do everybody a favor, and do not sink your time into this ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥.

Or charms (nobody uses these but esports leagues, they are eye sores) and maybe a skin, but it is rare to get a half decent skin due to the quality giving every character around like 3-4 good skins with 12 filler skins that were made to make it look like a character has more content then they actually do.

A: jetpack cat or moira (though i do recomme…

This game uses something called EOMM (Engagement Optimized Matchmaking). The idea is to keep you hovering around a 50% win rate. To do that, it'll regularly throw you into lobbies where you have virtually no chance of winning, but it'll also occasionally give you easy matches where your team completely stomps the enemy.

The end result is that about half of your games are either complete blowouts or hopeless losses, with very few close, competitive matches. The whole experience is made even worse by the fact that so many people refuse to play tanks or healers and the meta revolves around counter-picking so you are forced into the same 10 heroes if you want to win.

of course, none of this matters if you just "play for fun", but i struggle to find the "fun" in playing one-sided matches all the time.

Overwatch will always be a good game, everybody knows what Overwatch is and was once upon a time called Onlywatch. The reason for this being a negative review is the match-making. It's godawful, one game you will have a decent team and an average game. The next 10 games you will have newborns on your team playing against an e-sports team. This is referring to unranked btw, games are decided before you even start the round. Complete stomps total waste of time. Sure the games are ''quick'' and finding another one is also ''quick'' but in those ''quick'' games it will feel like you're watching an un-skippable AD. You also get punished for leaving even when it's inevitable.

Ranked is ranked, good player = high rank, Improving player = climbing ranks. Ranked is the only playable mode if you aren't looking to waste your time playing the game, unless you have friends of course. Although the cons are the higher your rank the more is expected of you, which can be draining if you just want to play the game to chill or relax. If you don't mind getting stomped in unranked/quickplay or w/e you want to call it. I might come off as a crying baby, fair.

But this is not an opinion it's a fact. It's an online PvP hero shooter with match-making slop. I don't mind losing at all, it's just not fun when the loses are only stomps which is 95% of the time in unranked/quickplay. Blizzard fix match-making.

Bear with I'm just a casual, but OH BOY, this game has little to no idea where it's going, if you play for fun, casually, there's no fun to be had, either you crush the enemy team, or your teammates look at the floor half the game.

Add to this characters with more and more mobility, and smaller hitboxes, if your team can't hit any shot, then good luck trying to win a game, or getting out of spawn even.

After years of NOTHING, they finally released new characters, once decent, 3 MEH, and a spawn of Satan that somehow has the smallest hitbox, full flight, heals itself, and can bring an ally that can still shoot in the air (yay Bastion Cat).

I had so much Nostlagia playing this game, and a lot of FOMO because of the tons of events, but the recent changes are too much to handle for me, MONEY MONEY MONEY is the game now, Kiriko released in october 2022 and has a whooping 42 skins, Hazard released 2 years later in 2024 has 4...

Domina is the best release recently because her kit is simple, yet interesting, but what's the point when the other 4 released characters alongside her have mobility, dashes, complete invulnerability zone, better zone heals than lucio (and shoots behind walls)

New character is also just skin bait to release 30 lines of skin (and reused some of Tracers animations too)

Can't wait to see the next characters they will release (probably someone that gives a pet to an ally that gives heals, damage boosts, and can shoot close enemies, so that Zenyatta ends up completely in the thrash can like my boi Lucio after Mizuki)

I can finally say, I Quit this game, bye.

claims.claim: Reviewers criticize the pricing of cosmetics, pointing out excessive costs for individual skins and bundles.

citations.review_text:
If anyone is wanting to play the game just don't. This game has gone so far down the ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ it's more funny then it is sad. Mix the greediness of Blizzard, the incompetence of the devs, many issues and a toxic community your mental state goes down the drain. 

SKINS AND TRANSACTIONS:
Lets start with the macro transactions. $45AUD for a single skin which is a few pixels on your screen is insane. Then the skins don't even justify their price. Mythic skins wer pretty cool when they released matching something to do with the character and some lore. Now they are just cyberpunk crap for people it doesn't even fit like SewerRat (JunkRat). Plus the price of them is like $80AUD which is the price of a full triple a game. They also know the skins are becoming weaker because they released some tier between Legendary and Mythic which are pretty much just ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ versions of Mythics. Not to mention its the same characters getting skins over and over. I mean Mercy has two Mythics before half the roster has even got one. It's obvious the game is becoming a skin collector instead of an actual game.

DEVS:
I used to give them the benifit of the doubt over and over but now I can clearly say they are some of the stupidest people to ever create a game. They throw random darts at a spinning dart board to make decisions. Every character to release is overtuned as ♥♥♥♥ then they nerf them 6ft under and keep them there until they want to buff the numbers. You have poorly designed characters like Maui (Mauga), Sombra and Cat. Mauga's whole kit is to play braindead as possible. Sombra is getting rework after rework because the devs don't know how to make her work, even though they have proven she can work and keep her hero fantasy. They had Mirrorwatch a few years ago where Sombra became a Support and she worked so much better there then as a DPS yet the devs refuse to switch her to Support and Illari to DPS. Cat since release has been one annoying as character. Infinite flight should not …

TLDR - I used to love Overwatch, it's heroes , and it's story but today's Overwatch is an empty husk of what it could have been.
I do not recommend putting significant time or money into this game and if you've never played it before please do not start now.

- Activision Blizzard has demonstrated biblical levels of greed in the monetization of this game. I'll use only one example, A one hundred dollar cosmetic pack.
- Overwatch (formerly Overwatch 2) has delivered on effectively zero of its promises over the last several years including any and all story content 
- The matchmaking is a complete hellscape in any mode 
- Several heroes are simply unplayable unless you learn every single niche interaction they have and even then you will still get abused by any newly released hero
- Finally there's the endless cycle of recycled content, lack of rewards, and new ways to play being created then inevitably abandoned a year or so later
Gameplay is... fine, but don't buy anything from the shops. The cosmetics they sell are heavily overpriced.

I've played this game on and off since its inception and despite some longer breaks from it, I always keep coming back, main reasons being to socially game with friends and I enjoy the core gameplay. I'm also a fan of many designs and characters in the game and I think its gotten very far in the quality of life department with some gameplay changes over the years. 
I still have fun playing it and that is why I give it a thumbs up.

However, some things just fly right past my radar of interest, like how the game does its events and cosmetics. Especially all these different tiers of cosmetics and the cost of them ... these just result in an immediate skip for me.
My main gripe is actually the menu UI ... it used to be much better in my opinion, it was clearer, neater, not bloated like it is now.
The game also needs more maps, more so than it needs new heroes.
Gameplay is... fine, but don't buy anything from the shops. The cosmetics they sell are heavily overpriced.

claims.claim: Reviewers state that the game lacks promised story and PvE content.

citations.review_text:
Mostly on Battlenet, I have been playing Overwatch almost since its launch. I remember the so-called "good old days" with great cinematics, ideas, and even a GOTY to its name. I think fondly about the era when I had an LA Gladiators sticker on my water bottle and looked forward to when Doomfist would finally be added to the game as a DPS hero. But I also remember the rise and fall of OWL, the lootboxes are gambling crisis, the horrendously handled launch of OW2 (now just Overwatch again) and, yes, even the PvE story mode debacle. Overwatch is a horribly handled, mentally tormenting, rage-inducing atrocious 6v6 to 5v5 now to sometimes also 6v6 hero shooter made by an abominable, greedy, maniacal, soulless corporation that would rather give Kiriko another 5 billion skins that stop sexually harassing their employees. It continues only existing so they they can pump out more bundles, battlepasses, and Japanese heroes, and it is a cognitohazard so powerful that it killed Twomad. It sucks, and I hate it.

But what am I going to do? Not play Overwatch? Hell no.

TLDR - I used to love Overwatch, it's heroes , and it's story but today's Overwatch is an empty husk of what it could have been.
I do not recommend putting significant time or money into this game and if you've never played it before please do not start now.

- Activision Blizzard has demonstrated biblical levels of greed in the monetization of this game. I'll use only one example, A one hundred dollar cosmetic pack.
- Overwatch (formerly Overwatch 2) has delivered on effectively zero of its promises over the last several years including any and all story content 
- The matchmaking is a complete hellscape in any mode 
- Several heroes are simply unplayable unless you learn every single niche interaction they have and even then you will still get abused by any newly released hero
- Finally there's the endless cycle of recycled content, lack of rewards, and new ways to play being created then inevitably abandoned a year or so later

Constant bad decisions from Blizzard are honestly what really makes this game feel unfun or redundant to play. As of right now the only quickplay option is 6v6, and I very much dislike 6v6. I know it's temporary, but having to deal with this after learning stadium is being discontinued has made the game practically unplayable for me.
Blizzard has a problem with releasing half-baked game modes and giving up on them too quick rather than committing and making them more enjoyable for players. We were supposed to get a story mode PvE but that never happened. Hero mastery was fun even if it wasn't a main game mode, and I am still upset about that being removed. Stadium was flawed, but overall a great addition to the game and I knew so many people who ONLY played Overwatch for stadium. It's disappointing but not surprising that instead of working to improve stadium and add more heroes, Blizzard is simply abandoning it.
This current "hacked" 1-3-2 6v6 event has made the game unplayable for me. There is no 5v5 quickplay at the moment, and even if I know it's coming back it is upsetting knowing I have to wait until next week just to play this game. 
Blizzard needs to start listening to their player base and put more effort into making this game enjoyable again.
